items.name: string — lowercase-hyphenated, from package manifest
items.root_path: string — relative path to root within repo
items.language: string — typescript, python, go, rust, java, yaml, etc.
items.base_path: string | null — URL prefix stripped by reverse proxy or framework router (e.g. '/api', '/api/v1'). Optional; emit only when an external prefix is stripped before forwarding to internal routes. Connection resolution strips this from outbound paths before matching exposed endpoints.
exposes: string — format depends on type (see prompt)

items.target: string — name of called service/library (can be external)
items.protocol: rest | grpc | events | db | internal | sdk | k8s | tf | helm | import — canonical buckets (kafka/rabbitmq/nats/sqs/pubsub/sse -> events; postgres/mysql/mongodb/redis/sql -> db; graphql/http -> rest); unrecognized values are accepted and bucketed to 'other' (fallback, not reject)
items.method: string — GET/POST/etc, produce, consume, import, call, deploy, configure
items.path: string — format depends on protocol (see prompt)
items.source_file: string | null — relative path only, no symbol suffix (e.g. 'src/auth.ts')
items.source_symbol: string | null — symbol/function name at the call site (e.g. 'validateToken'); omit or set null when the call site is not a named symbol
items.target_file: string | null — relative path in callee (null if unknown)
items.target_symbol: string | null — symbol/function name in callee (null if unknown)
items.evidence: string — exact code snippet (≤ 3 lines) proving this connection

items.connection_index: integer — 0-based index into connections[] identifying which connection this schema describes; required — schemas without a valid connection_index are skipped by the contract validator
items.name: string — schema/type name
